name: session-lights
description: A small desktop panel for local coding sessions.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/ui/tsconfig.json && node build/scripts/build.js
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && node --experimental-sqlite node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test
scripts.clean: node -e "const p = require('node:path'); const root = process.cwd(); const target = p.resolve(root, 'build'); if (p.dirname(target) !== root) throw Error('Invalid build path'); require('node:fs').rmSync(target, { recursive: true, force: true });"

author: Toni Esteso
